intro.title: Component Composition
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple user profile card by combining multiple Vue components. You will learn component composition, which is the practice of building larger, reusable interfaces by nesting smaller components. The main technologies involved are Vue single-file components, props for passing data, and template structure. By the end, you will understand how to structure and connect components to create modular and maintainable Vue applications.
intro.usecase: Component composition is fundamental to building scalable Vue applications like e-commerce platforms, where you compose product cards, filters, and shopping carts into cohesive pages. In admin dashboards, you combine reusable charts, data tables, and control panels to create complex interfaces efficiently. This pattern allows developers to assemble modular UI blocks—like forms with input groups, validation messages, and submit buttons—without rewriting code. By mastering composition, you can construct maintainable features such as nested navigation menus or modal dialogs with consistent behavior across an application.
